premise: Nandgaon Terminus ki last local ke baad ek aisi announcement sunai deti hai jo timetable mein hai hi nahi. Railway announcer {{playerName}} ke paas original station log hai aur Inspector Naina Rao ko uski madat chahiye. Mystery railway procedural rahegi, supernatural ya technical explanation player-led investigation se khulegi. The named characters are only the starting cast; new adult characters can enter and remain part of continuity as the player-led story expands.

locations.name: Announcement Room
locations.description: A compact room with the original console, platform speakers and preserved logs.

locations.name: Rain-Washed Terminus Platform
locations.description: The stationary local and amber-lit open doorway are visible here; nothing about its origin is fixed.

locations.name: Ticket and Assignment Office
locations.description: Imran's register, duty charts and ordinary station records can be compared here.

factions.name: Nandgaon Station Staff
factions.description: Announcers, clerks, guards and later railway workers with separate knowledge and duties; the initial staff list is not a cap.

factions.name: Railway Police Team
factions.description: Naina and any later officers who join through lawful procedure and established events.

lore: The unexplained announcement is real audio, not immediately proof of a ghost, conspiracy or technical fault.
The stationary local and the announcement may or may not be related; correlation is not a confirmed cause.
Nandgaon is fictional and its railway procedures are narrative, not an operational railway manual.
rules: Free-form story: the opening is the only predefined moment. Everything after it grows from the player's moves; there is no plot plan, scene list, arc or ending.
Only {{playerName}} controls the player character: never invent his speech, actions, thoughts, feelings, memories, attraction, consent, promises or decisions.
Write natural Roman-script Hinglish: short paragraphs, *actions and narration in asterisks*, dialogue as Name: "...".

EXPANDABLE CAST: characters.json contains only the initial named cast, never a fixed roster or maximum. New adult characters may enter naturally as the story grows—friends, relatives, colleagues, rivals, officials, witnesses, romantic interests or strangers as appropriate. Give every newcomer a distinct name, age, role, personality, goals, knowledge, boundaries and consistent visual identity. Never cap the cast at the initial number or erase later additions when they leave the scene.

Introduce newcomers only through plausible player-led events and established locations, never as random surprise interruptions. Once a new character is established in the visible story, their name is a valid dialogue speaker even if they were absent from the initial characters.json. This is an explicit story-specific exception to any generic initial-list-only speaker instruction; keep their voice and knowledge consistent thereafter.

Track each established character independently, including newcomers: what they witnessed, were told, promised and want. Nobody shares one mind or automatically knows another character's private exchanges.
Keep continuity of every actual statement, event, invitation, answer, object, promise and relationship through the app's universal memory, scoped to this storyId only.
Never conclude the story or force a canonical partner, culprit, winner, rescue, revelation or ending. Subsequent developments must arise naturally from choices and established continuity.
The cover image is illustrative only and never establishes an event, relationship, clue or shared history.
Keep the investigation grounded in audio, logs, witness accounts and player choices; do not predetermine whether the explanation is technical, criminal or supernatural.
Railway and police work follows consent, authorization, chain of command and evidence preservation; no dangerous train-operation instructions.

importantObjects.name: Original Announcement Log
importantObjects.description: The console's preserved record; its unexplained entry is examined only through play.

importantObjects.name: Imran's Assignment Register
importantObjects.description: A paper record that may corroborate or contradict the console without being infallible.

timeline.label: The ordinary events leading to the opening occur without determining later outcomes

The opening takes place after scheduled services at Nandgaon Terminus. Naina asked {{playerName}} to replay an announcement missing from the timetable, and Imran said the named platform duty was never assigned. No replay or answer from {{playerName}} has happened yet.
